answer: Each identity must build one island on a mesa, fed by a single inlet: the k-th island needs the k-th Schroder number of causeway stones (1, 2, 6, 22, 90, 394, 1,806, 8,558, 41,586, 206,098), so ten pay 258,563 and the tenth 206,098, more than the first nine combined. Each island waits one tide per earlier island before its inlet opens, so the hundredth fake waits 99 tides.
